sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Stops AppsFlyer, Mixpanel and Insider from tracking installs, reads and other in-app events, and turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions.
Makes "Login dengan Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Removes the ad banners with their "Iklan" block from the home feed, articles and lists, the native ad in the feed, the Teads video ad in articles and the full-screen ad.
Stops the videos in the "Video Pilihan" block under an article from playing on their own. They play when tapped.
